title: Order Management Dashboard
content: Build order management dashboard for admin/seller use. Header: title, order count, date range picker, export button. Filters: status tabs (All, Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled), search by order ID or customer. Table: columns for order ID, customer name, date, items count, total, status badge, actions. Status badges: yellow/pending, blue/processing, purple/shipped, green/delivered, red/cancelled. Actions: view details, update status dropdown, print label. Bulk actions: select multiple, bulk status update. Pagination below table.

variants.simple: Create order management table with status, filters, and actions.

variants.advanced: Build comprehensive order management dashboard for admin/seller portal. Page header: flex justify-between, "Orders" title (text-2xl font-bold), order count badge, date range picker (preset options: Today, Last 7 Days, This Month, Custom), Export dropdown (CSV, PDF). Stats cards row: total orders, pending orders, revenue today, average order value - each in card with icon and trend indicator. Filters section: status tabs (All, Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled, Refunded) with counts, search input (placeholder "Search order ID, customer, email..."), advanced filters button opening drawer with date range, payment method, shipping method, amount range, product filters. Table structure: responsive with horizontal scroll on mobile, sticky first column. Columns: checkbox for selection, Order ID (clickable link, monospace font), Customer (name + email, avatar optional), Date (relative + full on hover), Items (count with hover preview), Total (formatted currency), Payment status (Paid/Pending/Failed badge), Fulfillment status (badge with appropriate color), Actions column. Status badges: Pending (bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800), Processing (bg-blue-100 text-blue-800), Shipped (bg-purple-100 text-purple-800), Out for Delivery (bg-indigo-100), Delivered (bg-green-100 text-green-800), Cancelled (bg-red-100 text-red-800), Refunded (bg-gray-100 text-gray-800). Row actions dropdown: View Details (opens order detail page/modal), Update Status (submenu with status options), Print Packing Slip, Print Shipping Label, Contact Customer, Cancel Order, Issue Refund. Bulk actions bar: appears when items selected, shows count selected, actions: Update Status, Print Labels, Export Selected, Delete. Order detail modal/page: customer info, shipping address, billing address, items list with images, order timeline/history, internal notes, payment details, shipping tracking. Real-time updates: WebSocket for new orders, status changes highlight briefly. Sound notification option for new orders. Sorting: click column headers to sort. Pagination: items per page selector (25, 50, 100), page numbers. Empty state: appropriate message based on active filters. Loading: skeleton table rows.
